title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 22
description: Ten questions on Genesis 22: Abraham is tested on the mountain in Moriah, and Yahweh provides a ram.

questions.text: To which land did God tell Abraham to take Isaac?
questions.explanation: God said, "Take your son, your only son, Isaac, whom you love, and go into the land of Moriah."

questions.text: How many of his young men did Abraham take with him?
questions.explanation: Abraham saddled his donkey and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son.

questions.text: On which day did Abraham see the place far off?
questions.explanation: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place far off.

questions.text: What did Abraham lay on Isaac to carry?
questions.explanation: Abraham laid the wood of the burnt offering on Isaac his son, and he took the fire and the knife in his own hand.

answers.text: The wood for the burnt offering

questions.text: What did Isaac ask his father on the way?
questions.explanation: Isaac said, "Here is the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?"

answers.text: Where the lamb for the burnt offering was
Where the altar would be built
Why they had left the donkey behind

questions.text: What did the angel say he now knew about Abraham?
questions.explanation: Yahweh's angel called to Abraham and said, "For now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from me."

answers.text: That Abraham would become a king

questions.text: What did Abraham see caught in the thicket by its horns?
questions.explanation: Abraham saw behind him a ram caught in the thicket by his horns, and offered him up as a burnt offering instead of his son.

questions.text: What name did Abraham give to that place?
questions.explanation: Abraham called the name of that place "Yahweh Will Provide".

questions.text: To what did Yahweh compare Abraham's offspring in Genesis 22?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said He would multiply Abraham's offspring like the stars of the heavens and like the sand which is on the seashore.

answers.text: The dust of the earth and the trees of the field
The fish of the sea and the birds of the sky
The stars of the heavens and the sand on the seashore
The grass of the field and the drops of rain

questions.text: Who became the father of Rebekah?
questions.explanation: Verse 23 says, "Bethuel became the father of Rebekah."
